sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate now faithfully encodes the conditional direct calculation: all required properties target the ship, survivalCraftAvailableCapacity is directly constrained as xsd:integer, the mass values use kilogram QuantityValue structures, and the SPARQL query selects only failed comparisons using the correct violation direction.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Reverse the applicable-case SPARQL constraint logic. SHACL SPARQL SELECT results are violations, but the current FILTER selects nodes satisfying both capacity comparisons, thereby rejecting compliant data and allowing failing comparisons to pass. Select only failed comparisons, for example: FILTER (?available < (?persons + ?additional) || ?launch < ?loaded).
